steps: 1. Select 'Free WiFi' in Facilities & Amenities
2. Select 'Luxury' in Hotel Type
3. Select 'Bed & Breakfast' in Board Basis
4. Enter a valid location in Location Area
test_cases.expected_result: All filters are applied successfully; results update dynamically.

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to add one more filter than allowed for Hotels
preconditions: User is on the Hotels tab with maximum filters applied
steps: 1. Attempt to add another filter in Facilities & Amenities
test_cases.expected_result: Adding another filter is blocked; no additional filter is applied.

test_cases.test_case: Rapid removal of active filters
preconditions: User has multiple active filters applied
steps: 1. Click 'Remove Filter' on the first active filter
2. Immediately click 'Remove Filter' on the second active filter
test_cases.expected_result: Active filters are updated correctly; results refresh accordingly.

test_cases.test_case: Reset all filters after applying some
steps: 1. Click 'Reset all filters'
test_cases.expected_result: All filters are cleared; results refresh to show all listings.

test_cases.test_case: Sort results using the first sorting option
preconditions: User is on the results page
steps: 1. Select 'Price: Low to High' from the sorting dropdown
test_cases.expected_result: Results are sorted by price from low to high.

test_cases.test_case: Sort results using the second sorting option
preconditions: User is on the results page
steps: 1. Select 'Price: High to Low' from the sorting dropdown
test_cases.expected_result: Results are sorted by price from high to low.

test_cases.test_case: Submit Review without Photos
steps: 1. Navigate to the Reviews section on the Detail Page
2. Enter <Overall Rating> in the Overall Rating field
3. Click 'Add Row' in the Category Ratings section
4. Enter <Cleanliness Rating> in the Cleanliness field
5. Enter <Service Rating> in the Service field
6. Enter <Location Rating> in the Location field
7. Enter <Written Feedback> in the Written Feedback field
8. Click Submit Review
test_cases.expected_result: A success notification is displayed; the message 'Review submitted successfully' is shown

test_cases.test_case: Submit Review with Photos
steps: 1. Navigate to the Reviews section on the Detail Page
2. Enter <Overall Rating> in the Overall Rating field
3. Click 'Add Row' in the Category Ratings section
4. Enter <Cleanliness Rating> in the Cleanliness field
5. Enter <Service Rating> in the Service field

7. Enter <Written Feedback> in the Written Feedback field

test_cases.test_case: Submit review with minimum overall rating
preconditions: user must have completed a booking
steps: 1. Enter <minimum allowed value> in the Overall_Rating field
2. Fill all required fields in Category_Ratings with <minimum allowed value>
3. Click Submit
test_cases.expected_result: Form submits successfully; review is created with the minimum overall rating

test_cases.test_case: Submit review with maximum category ratings
preconditions: user must have completed a booking
steps: 1. Enter <maximum allowed value> in the Overall_Rating field
2. Fill all required fields in Category_Ratings with <maximum allowed value>
3. Click Submit
test_cases.expected_result: Form submits successfully; review is created with the maximum overall rating

test_cases.test_case: Submit review with one category rating below minimum
preconditions: user must have completed a booking
steps: 1. Enter <minimum allowed value> in the Overall_Rating field
2. Fill Cleanliness in Category_Ratings with <minimum allowed value>
3. Fill Service in Category_Ratings with <minimum allowed value>
4. Fill Location in Category_Ratings with <one unit below minimum>

test_cases.test_case: Upload file over size limit
preconditions: user must have completed a booking
steps: 1. Enter <minimum allowed value> in the Overall_Rating field
2. Fill all required fields in Category_Ratings with <minimum allowed value>
3. Upload a file that is one unit over the size limit
4. Click Submit
test_cases.expected_result: Submission is blocked; an error is shown indicating the file exceeds the size limit

test_cases.test_case: Book Now for a selected offer
steps: 1. Select 'Hotels' from the Service Type Filter dropdown
2. Enter <valid destination> in the Destination Filter
3. Select <valid travel date> in the Travel Dates Filter
4. Enter <valid email> in the Newsletter Subscription field
5. Click the 'Book Now' button for a selected offer
test_cases.expected_result: applies promotional code automatically or redirects to pre-filled search

test_cases.test_case: Leave the Newsletter Subscription field blank and submit
steps: 1. Leave the Newsletter Subscription field blank
2. Fill all other filters as needed
3. Click Book Now
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Newsletter Subscription field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Enter an invalid email format in the Newsletter Subscription field
steps: 1. Enter <invalid email format> in the Newsletter Subscription field
2. Fill all other filters as needed
3. Click Book Now
test_cases.expected_result: Newsletter Subscription field displays an error: 'Must be a valid email address'

test_cases.test_case: Enter today's date in the Travel Dates Filter
steps: 1. Select 'Hotels' from the Service_Type_Filter
2. Enter today's date in the Travel_Dates_Filter
3. Click Book Now
test_cases.expected_result: Redirects to a pre-filled search with discounted rates applied

test_cases.test_case: Enter yesterday's date in the Travel Dates Filter
steps: 1. Select 'Flights' from the Service_Type_Filter
2. Enter yesterday's date in the Travel_Dates_Filter
3. Click Book Now
test_cases.expected_result: Redirect is blocked; visible error indicating travel dates must be today or later

test_cases.test_case: Enter a very long string in the Destination_Filter
steps: 1. Select 'Packages' from the Service_Type_Filter
2. Enter a string longer than 200 characters in the Destination_Filter
test_cases.expected_result: Input is either accepted or truncated with a visible indicator

test_cases.test_case: Enter an email with leading and trailing whitespace in the Newsletter_Subscription field
steps: 1. Enter '   example@example.com   ' in the Newsletter_Subscription field
test_cases.expected_result: Leading/trailing whitespace is trimmed; saved value shown in detail page has no extra spaces

test_cases.test_case: User successfully logs out
steps: 1. Click the Logout button
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the home page and the session is terminated.

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to access a protected page after logout
steps: 1. Click the Logout button
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page when attempting to access a protected page

test_cases.test_case: Rapid consecutive logout attempts
steps: 1. Click the Logout button
2. Immediately click the Logout button again
test_cases.expected_result: Second logout attempt is ignored; user remains on the home page without a new session termination

test_cases.test_case: Access protected page after logout
steps: 1. Click the Logout button
2. Attempt to navigate to a protected page
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page with a message indicating session termination
